        "All five owned paths and the entire 887-line diff were read. The patch passes a named borrowed OperationRequest through normal sending and credential validation, removes the fixed EWS URL from credentials, and validates with the queued operation method, URI, headers and body. Manual NTLM uses that same request for its two handshake messages. These are original source facts; the external protocol documents and paired Necko implementation are unread.",
        "At this landing the recovering runner returns the response from successful credential validation to its operation loop rather than sending the operation again there. Runners that waited for the error-handling line retry their own requests. The prompt loop refreshes credentials after the prompt, continues only on ProtocolError::Authentication and returns other errors. A non-401 response passes this authentication layer; that does not establish operation-level success or an exactly-once contract.",
        "The fixed accepted phase differs. The old credentials.rs and ntlm.rs paths are absent; the provider delegates Basic and NTLM to Necko. The current early-failure handler returns unit, the caller continues its request loop after recovery, and network/security failures propagate after their optional alerts. The existing exact public send_request snapshot is reused for method/URI/headers/body preservation rather than copied.",
        "All nine actual review bodies and two replacement blocks were read. The author explains the borrowed-body/Graph ownership constraint and names handshake messages from external documents. Actual source adopts the Err(err.into()) simplification and grammar fix. For connection-drop handling the author corrects the earlier suggestion that the proposed loop already preserved behavior: final code retries only authentication failures and returns other errors. Approval and Done are not the adoption proof.",
        "The complete primary includes an experimental reporter patch and local test claims, a maintainer preference for preserving original requests without serializing operations, and a later report that the symptom persisted after landing. No complete cure, live authentication, native transport, performance or fresh test result follows. No tests change in this patch. Comments, error roles, borrowing, naming and grouping were checked within the owned scope."
